'''Rod''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In 22 BBY, Rod participated in the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the battle, he was the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] turret [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] of [[Goji/Legends|Goji's]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]]. While he tried to shoot down a few vulture droids, his bomber dropped the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] that deactivated the droid army and awakened the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]].

==Equipment==
Rod's [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] helmet was custom painted with two winged creatures, one on each side of the helmet, displayed with wings spread in flight.

==Behind the scenes==
Rod was named for classic Japanese film monster [[Wikipedia:Rodan|Rodan]].<ref name="Rodan">{{SW|url=video/the-zillo-beast-episode-featurette|text="The Zillo Beast" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
